audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[3..6].side read Skill/Diana/Skill/Skill while content win[3..6] read Diana/Azir/Diana/Azir — four rows where the page gave two answers.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Diana, Diana, Skill, Diana, Azir, Diana, Azir) and it is coherent with the kit: she owns 4-5 on the refunded dash, Azir owns 6 when Emperor's Divide can wall it.
audit.corrected: Full layer aligned to content and packet, with each moved row's why rewritten to argue the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] credited Moonfall for the levels 4-5 window, but Moonfall is the level 6 ultimate; spikes[2] named Riftmaker/Night Harvester timers with nothing to source them.
audit.why: Diana's spikes in this lane are the Crescent Strike refund on Lunar Rush (available from level 3), Moonfall at 6 (100/90/80, 475 range), and her first-item burst. Azir's are Nashor's and Emperor's Divide at 6.
audit.corrected: 4-5 spike restated as the refunded double Lunar Rush; 6 as Moonfall's 475 pull; first item without the invented item names.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only vaguely ("Moonlight marks reset her dash") with no cooldowns anywhere — breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all. Several fields also called Crescent Strike a dash.
audit.why: Crescent Strike (8/7.5/7/6.5/6, 900) applies Moonlight; Lunar Rush (22/20/18/16/14, 825) has NO cooldown against a Moonlight-afflicted target and the mark is consumed either way. So dodging the arc is what puts her dash back on a 14-22 second timer. Azir's R creates terrain, which is what stops that dash.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns stated, the Moonlight-refund rule made explicit, and Crescent Strike no longer described as the dash.

audit.why: Crescent Strike reveals non-stealthed targets for 3 seconds and Moonfall also reveals — no stealth champion is involved here, so nothing to add. All four packet suspectNames (Crescent Strike, Pale Cascade, Emperor's Divide x2) are FALSE POSITIVES: every one matches the kit file exactly.

notes: All four packet suspectNames are false positives — Crescent Strike, Pale Cascade and Emperor's Divide all match the kit files. Real defect found instead: three fields called Crescent Strike a dash. It is a 900-range arc that applies Moonlight; the dash is Lunar Rush, and the interaction that decides the lane is that Lunar Rush has NO cooldown against a Moonlight-marked target. whys[3] (levels 4-5) described Moonfall, a level 6 ultimate — corrected.
